'''Gorgmonger''' was the term applied to any sentient being who farmed and sold [[Gorg/Legends|gorgs]], such as [[Gragra/Legends|Gragra]] on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
